messages:
marta: Quick handoff — I'm stepping out for ~60m. No P1s atm. Leaving a short watchlist:
- encoder-pool CPU trending +8% over baseline for ~3h, a couple of pod restarts seen
- prefetch KV latency spikes (~200-350ms p95) on eu-west nodes, seems correlated with bursty prefills
If you see alerts, follow runbooks. I'll check back in at ~16:40 UTC.

sam: Thanks — I'll cover. Do you want me to mute the noisy single-sample jitter alert or keep as-is?

marta: Keep thresholds as-is for now, but mute the alert that fires on single-sample jitter (we had 5 false positives in last 24h). Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/prefetch-kv
Escalation: ping @ryan if latency > 400ms for >10m OR error rate >2%.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] prefetch-kv latency spike on prefetch-12 (eu-west-2) — p95=320ms, 3 occurrences in 8m

ryan: On it. I can already see a config drift in pool sizes after the autoscale tweak this morning. Pulling logs + recent deploy info.

anya: FYI I rolled a small backoff fix to the prefetch client at 12:05 UTC which should reduce retry thundering. Keep an eye for regressions.

sam: Looking at metrics now — p95 latency spikes line up with parent encoder CPU bumps. Quick query I'm watching:
``
sum(rate(encoder_cpu_seconds_total[5m])) by (node)
```
If encoder CPU is high on the same node, consider draining that node.

ryan: Found that prefetch-12 is running an older kernel with sporadic cgroup throttling anomalies. Plan: cordon + replace with fresh instance from eu-west image pool.

marta: Good catch. If replacement doesn't reduce p95 within 15m, escalate to infra and open a ticket with kernel version + dmesg + top outputs. Tag infra-oncall.

sam: Roger. ACTIONS: cordon prefetch-12 (starting now), watch p95 & 5xx rate; if no improvement by +20m, trigger redeploy of prefetch clients on eu-west and notify product owners. I'll update this thread after each step.

oncall-bot: [NOTE] scheduled maintenance window for eu-west infra at 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC — replacements may land in that window.

marta: Thanks team :raised_hands: Keep updates short here. If you hit a showstopper, escalate to P1 via pager as usual.

sam: Update: prefetch-12 cordoned and draining (pods shifting). p95 down to 210ms after eviction of noisy encoder pod. Monitoring.

ryan: Replaced instance now; new node kernel 5.15.78 applied. Early signs look better, will validate for 30m.

sam: Looks stable so far. Will unmute jitter alert after 60m if false positives stop.

marta: Back online, thank you all. Leaving this as a yellow-watch for the next shift.
